items.title: Karpenter v1.15: GPU-aware provisioning, smarter node repair, and more
items.summary: Karpenter v1.15 brings hardware-aware provisioning for NVIDIA GPU and EFA workloads through Dynamic Resource Allocation, volume-limit-aware scheduling, and Nitro Enclaves support, plus node repair as voluntary disruption with reboot-based recovery, terminate-first disruption, pod deletion cost management, and CEL expressions in kubelet configuration.
items.creator: Sajjan Gundapuneedi

items.title: Your guide to containers at AWS re:Invent 2026
items.summary: AWS re:Invent 2026 returns to Las Vegas, November 30 to December 4. This guide to the container track groups Amazon ECS, Amazon EKS, AWS Fargate, and Amazon ECR sessions by the kind of work you do, from running agents in production to platform engineering, inference, security, scale, and resilience, so you can start building your schedule.
items.creator: Bhavye Sharma
